description.en: Enables or disables one specific light slot (index 0-8) on a map. Never called from any shipped script in script_clean/; behavior reconstructed from the native implementation.
Handle of the map, from CMND_GET_MAP_HANDLE.
Index of the light slot to configure (0-8).
True to enable that light, false to disable it.

example.code:
// Turn off light slot 2 on the current map
CMND_SET_MAP_LIGHT_ENABLE(CMND_GET_MAP_HANDLE(), 2, false);
